preconditions.description: The number of integers n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each integer a_i in the list a must be between 0 and 9.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= len(s) <= 3 and all(c in '+-*' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must contain between 1 and 3 distinct symbols, each being either '+', '-', or '*'.

postconditions.description: The output must be a valid expression formed by the numbers and symbols.

postconditions.expression: any(c in s for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output must include at least one of the allowed symbols.
The output must have a length of 2n - 1 characters, consisting of n numbers and n - 1 symbols.
